headline: 油價上漲衝擊英國預算案
context: 油價這星期又上漲一波，讓英國財政官員希利（Healey）在籌備下個月的預算案時，處境更加艱難。財政部內部人士坦言，跟一個月前相比，現在的操作空間「更小」了。這波油價漲勢，發生在公債市場才剛經歷一輪劇烈拋售之後。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Treasury sources concede ‘less room’ for manoeuvre as global bond selloff also hikes government’s borrowing costs International bodies warn of rising debt and borrowing risks Burnham stands by claim UK is ‘in hock’ to bond markets Oil prices lurched upwards again on Thursday, creating a growing headache for UK policymakers ahead of John Healey’s budget next month. While Healey has been keen to present an upbeat picture of the UK’s economic prospects, Treasury sources concede the sharp jump in oil and gas prices means they have “less room” than a month ago. voice_text: 英國財政官員希利，最近的日子不太好過。油價這星期又上漲一波，讓他在籌備下個月的預算案時，處境更加艱難。財政部內部人士坦言，跟一個月前比，現在的操作空間「更小」了。這波油價漲勢，發生在公債市場才剛經歷一輪劇烈拋售之後。
